stem: Which tracer is best for a dynamic renal study requiring better image quality and faster clearance?
explanation: Tc-99m MAG3 is the best tracer for a dynamic renal study when better image quality and faster clearance are desired.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Renal Functioning Scan (MAG-3/DTPA)

optionExplanations.A: Correct because Tc-99m MAG3 has high extraction, better image quality, and faster clearance than DTPA.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because Tc-99m DTPA has lower extraction and less favourable image quality than MAG3.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because DMSA is used for a static cortical renal scan, not a dynamic renal study.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because plain abdominal X-ray contrast is not a renal nuclear medicine tracer.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because ultrasound alone does not provide a tracer-based dynamic renal function study.
